issue.title: 32.0 RC Testing Guide Feedback
issue.body:
This issue is to discuss the [32.0 Release Candidate Testing Guide](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide). If you have any feedback on the document, please leave a comment here.

Note: This is for feedback on the document, not on Bitcoin Core or on the 32.0 changes. Create a new issue or give feedback in the global issue [here](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36315). 

Thank you for taking a look at the guide and leaving your feedback.

events.body: Guix builders: note that for v32.0rc1 the `guix-codesign` step will fail. See #36256. But you still test everything else.
Guix builders: note that building on RISC-V will fail. See https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36233.

On the 32.0 RC Testing Guide doc, section 5.4.1's title should be updated to V32 Aliases. Also update the alias from `alias bcli31=...` to `alias bcli32=...`.

https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide#541-v31-aliases

Also, in Section 4 there's a reference to a previous version `v31.2` that should be corrected to `v31.1`.

https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide#4-obtain-previous-release

Successfully rebuilt all indices, sizes measured using `du -h -d 1`.
Before:
```
91G	./txospenderindex
69G	./txindex
13G	./blockfilter
172G	.
```
After:
```
83G	./txospenderindex
23G	./txindex
13G	./blockfilter
118G	.
```

I ran into another issue with `guix-codesign` for rc2, this time App Armor related:

```sh
zcat /var/log/guix/drvs/2s/v5049dk6ifphfm20xp7r0rdc1vm2bv-python-signapple-3fab3bb57f227f0dd31007b417683035f5204838-checkout.drv.gz
warning: unable to access '/etc/gitconfig': Permission denied
warning: unable to access '/etc/gitconfig': Permission denied
warning: unable to access '/etc/gitconfig': Permission denied
fatal: unknown error occurred while reading the configuration files
git-fetch: '/gnu/store/xz7xygq040vx78snmla70y03h6x9yypg-git-minimal-2.52.0/bin/git init --initial-branch=main' failed with exit code 128
```

According to Claude, and my own testing, adding this inside the profile `guix-helper { … }` block in `/etc/apparmor.d/guix-daemon`, helps:

```
# builtin:git-download runs git unchrooted; git treats EACCES on the
# system config as fatal (ENOENT would be fine).
/etc/gitconfig r,
```

I haven't filed an upstream issue yet.

In https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide#11-exportwatchonlywallet-new-rpc, the last part:

Stop the old node and clean up:

```bash
bcli32 stop && sleep 5  &&  datadir-cleanup
```

should be `bcli32` instead of `bcli31`

Similarly for https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide#12-exportasmap-new-rpc and https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide#13-getopenrpcinfo-and-rpcdiscover should be `bcli32`.

Thank you for the feedback

> In https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide#11-exportwatchonlywallet-new-rpc, the last part:
> 
> Stop the old node and clean up:
> 
> bcli32 stop && sleep 5  &&  datadir-cleanup
> should be `bcli32` instead of `bcli31`

Mhh no, we are stopping the old node, that is intentional. a few lines above we stop the v32 node and start importing the watchonlywallet on the "old" V31  node. Have change the wording a bit to clarify. 

> Similarly for https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide#12-exportasmap-new-rpc and https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide#13-getopenrpcinfo-and-rpcdiscover should be `bcli32`.

This one should indeed be V32, have corrected it. TY.

The expected output for `exportasmap` in the guide is:
```sh
{
  "path": "/path/to/DATA_DIR_32/asmap.dat",
  "bytes_written": 1582208,
  "file_hash": "..."
}
```

I think instead of "..." we could put the real file hash since everybody - following the guide - should get the same hash (`03580ade8ec0036ad3d6a5a91602b995c89387f722d3fee58127219de6aafc12`). 

Also, "Check that the file exists and isn't empty" runs `ls -l` so we could tell people to compare the bytes from this command to the one returned by the RPC.

Shouldn't we export the ASMAP from `bitcoind32` and import it into `bitcoind31` to verify the ASMAP import and check whether the ASMAP version hash in the log matches the `file_hash`? I tried this, and the ASMAP version log shows a different hash when importing the same ASMAP into `bitcoind32` and `bitcoind31`. ``` [erick@archlinux rctesting]$ bcli32 exportasmap $DATA_DIR_32/asmap.dat { "path": "/tmp/32-rc-test/asmap.dat", "bytes_written": 1582208, "file_hash": "03580ade8ec0036ad3d6a5a91602b995c89387f722d3fee58127219de6aafc12" } ```

At 2.2 PSBT v2 default it says:

> The output should be a transaction ID (txid):
> ```89be67d3cdf04192c718e6f1e6486b02172c53f5f39b0ab73de1c53b0707f1e3```

This could mislead readers into thinking their txid should exactly match this value. It would be better to indicate that this is an example txid, rather than the expected output.

The expected output in the guide for the estimatesmartfee for each mode is (https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide#25-estimatesmartfee-combined-estimator):

```
none=0.00000100 block_policy=0.00004000 mempool_policy=0.00000100
```

but shouldn't it be:
```sh
none=0.00000100 block_policy=0.00003000 mempool_policy=0.00000100
```

> I tried this, and the ASMAP version log shows a different hash when importing the same ASMAP into bitcoind32 and bitcoind31.

That is intentional. The hash calculation in v32 was changed to be compatible with sha256sum on the command line.
